description:
Shred ready. The Rossignol Mandate Junior 24-inch mountain bike is purpose-built for riders aged 9-12 (135–150 cm tall). Designed for young riders ready for true trail riding, it pairs a durable aluminium frame inspired by our adult Heretic model with 130 mm of travel front and rear for confident control on rugged trails. A dropper post boosts confidence in technical terrain, and grippy Maxxis tires deliver all-conditions traction for climbing and descending.

Optimized Fit & Sizing
Engineered for young riders aged 9 to 12 between 135cm and 150cm, this 24-inch frame features a low stand-over height for easy handling. It delivers the perfect balance of stability and safety, allowing growing shredders to master more aggressive terrain with total independence

100% Rossignol All-Mountain Geometry
The aluminum alloy frame utilizes a unique kinematic designed specifically for junior proportions. With 130mm of travel, it provides higher confidence and high-speed stability, making it a true "all-terrain toy" that evolves with your child's progression

Performance Suspension Tuned for Kids
Experience a plush, fluid ride with the 130mm Manitou fork and custom-tuned DVO rear shock. Our specific kinematics ensure the suspension works natively for lighter weights right out of the box, delivering high-level performance without the need to under-inflate.

Trail-Ready Traction
Equipped with Full Maxxis tires, the Mandate Junior 24" offers pro-level grip and elite traction. It allows young riders to corner with precision and giving them the safety and confidence to tackle technical trail features just like the pros, or the parents leading the way
